subject: K-Series Yellow Xenomorph
promptProvenance: Source prompt hashes identify the production contract; actual ImageGen prompts are separately preserved in the production state.

physicalAnchorReview.method: Manual source-image inspection of pelvis/hip-ring center for each pose, vertically projected to individually verified physical support. Ground coordinate uses exclusive occupied support bound plus existing three-source-pixel extraction guard, not a tail/weapon centroid. No source edits; target pivot is separate from observed roots. For this ground-run contract, the lowest visible plantar contact is the support convention; no undocumented airborne root motion is invented. Support is individually checked rather than inferred from total silhouette width.
